description:
When each dataset last changed and how often it refreshes. The quota-saver: for every dataset the API serves, `updated_at` (the newest timestamp actually in the
table, UTC) and `refresh_seconds` (how often it can change), with the endpoints it feeds. Poll this cheap
endpoint and only re-fetch a heavy payload such as /market/prices or /servers when its dataset's `updated_at`
has moved; cache reference data (items, monuments, ...) locally since it only changes with Facepunch's monthly
patch. Timestamps are read live from the database and cached for 60 seconds.
name: get_data_freshness
title: When each dataset last changed and how often it refreshes
